This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engenheiro de Software Especialista based in Brazil.

In this role, you will drive the development and evolution of complex backend systems, ensuring high standards of performance, scalability, and maintainability. You will play a key role in defining software architecture, designing robust integrations, and delivering reliable digital solutions. Working primarily with Java, you will contribute to services and applications that support large volumes of data and complex business operations. You will collaborate closely with Product, QA, Frontend, and Data teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. Beyond hands-on development, you will influence engineering standards, mentor junior developers, and promote technical excellence across the team. This is an opportunity to contribute to innovative digital healthcare solutions in a collaborative, agile, and technology-driven environment.

lists.content:
• Develop new features and continuously improve existing systems, prioritizing code quality, scalability, performance, and maintainability.

  • Define, evaluate, and evolve software architecture, proposing structural improvements to strengthen system reliability and efficiency.

  • Design and implement integrations between internal and external services, including APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.

  • Write clean, efficient, reusable, and testable code in accordance with engineering best practices and established technical standards.

  • Develop and execute automated and unit tests to ensure software quality and minimize production issues.

  • Collaborate with Product, QA, Frontend, and Data teams to coordinate end-to-end development and delivery.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, promoting technical consistency, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

  • Monitor application performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimizations to improve system efficiency.

  • Work with relational and non-relational databases, optimizing complex queries and managing large volumes of data.

  • Document software architectures, technical workflows, and engineering practices to support maintainability and knowledge transfer.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, refinement sessions, and retrospectives, contributing proactive solutions and technical insights.

  • Mentor junior developers, supporting their technical growth and encouraging high-quality engineering practices.

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while maintaining technical judgment and code quality.

    • Requirements:

  • Solid professional experience in backend software development using Java.

  • Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases, particularly MySQL and MongoDB.

  • Experience handling large volumes of data and developing, analyzing, and optimizing complex database queries.

  • Good understanding of modular service architectures, microservices, and RESTful APIs.

  • Experience with automated testing, version control using Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered coding assistants and development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor.

  • Previous experience working within digital product teams and Agile development environments.

  • Strong software architecture knowledge and the ability to identify opportunities for structural and technical improvements.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when addressing complex technical challenges.

  • Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Proactive mindset, technical ownership, and ability to mentor and support less experienced developers.

    • Nice to have:

  • Previous experience in healthtech companies or organizations with highly complex technical environments.

  • Experience with AWS services, particularly EC2, RDS, SQS, and Elastic Beanstalk.

  • Hands-on experience building software solutions with AI-powered development tools such as Claude, Cursor, and Codex.

  • Knowledge of observability, application monitoring, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.

  • Experience working with high-scale systems and large data volumes.

    • Benefits:

  • Monthly flexible benefits allowance: R$1,059 through CAJU, distributed across meal, food, mobility, health, home office, culture, and education categories.

  • Health insurance: AMIL S450 apartment-plan coverage, with 30% co-payment for consultations and exams and 40% for emergency room services. Coverage can be extended to eligible dependents (spouses and children up to 24 years old), with an additional monthly cost of R$506.86 per dependent, deducted from payroll, plus applicable co-payments.

  • Medication allowance: R$100 monthly through Omni Saúde for prescribed medications purchased through the designated healthcare provider.

  • Physical and mental healthcare: Free access to online consultations through the healthcare platform and Zenklub.

  • Childcare assistance: Support according to the applicable regional collective bargaining agreement.

  • Extended parental leave: Option of six months of maternity leave and 30 days of paternity leave.

  • Life insurance: Coverage provided through SulAmérica.

  • Birthday day off: An additional day off during your birthday month.

  • Fitness and wellness: Access to TotalPass and Wellhub.

  • Educational opportunities: Discounts and partnerships with various educational institutions.

  • SESC membership: Access to sports, cultural activities, leisure programs, and courses, with special conditions for employees and dependents.

  • Transportation allowance: Optional transportation benefit, subject to a 6% salary deduction.

  • Remote work: Flexibility to work remotely from Brazil.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Akamai / CDN Engineer based in Brazil.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Akamai / CDN Engineer to take technical ownership of enterprise content delivery and edge security services in a complex production environment. In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize CDN architectures to ensure high availability, security, and web performance. You will manage Akamai configurations, including properties, caching policies, origins, certificates, DNS, and edge security solutions. Working closely with cloud, infrastructure, DevSecOps, and cybersecurity teams, you will help strengthen digital delivery capabilities and protect critical applications. You will also drive automation initiatives through APIs, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines, improving operational efficiency and deployment consistency. This is an opportunity to contribute to large-scale technology environments, solve challenging infrastructure problems, and shape reliable, secure, and high-performance digital experiences.

lists.content:
• Take end-to-end technical ownership of enterprise Akamai CDN services, ensuring their availability, performance, security, and operational reliability.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve content delivery and edge security architectures to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Configure, maintain, and optimize Akamai Property Manager properties, including rules, behaviors, origins, caching policies, and traffic management configurations.
  • Manage CDN certificates and TLS configurations through Akamai Certificate Provisioning System (CPS), as well as DNS and traffic routing through Edge DNS.
  • Implement and optimize edge security solutions, including Web Application Firewall (WAF), App & API Protector, Kona Site Defender, Bot Manager, rate limiting, and DDoS protection.
  • Monitor traffic performance, availability, and security using Akamai Control Center, DataStream, mPulse, and other relevant monitoring and analytics tools.
  • Troubleshoot complex CDN and edge-related issues, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions to maintain service continuity.
  • Provide production support, manage technical incidents, conduct root cause analyses, and coordinate change management activities.
  • Automate CDN configurations and deployments using Akamai CLI, Akamai APIs (PAPI), Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with application development and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) teams to implement effective caching, cache invalidation, Fast Purge, and web performance strategies.
  • Optimize content delivery by leveraging HTTP/HTTPS protocols, caching mechanisms, headers, cookies, compression, and HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 capabilities.
  • Work closely with cloud, infrastructure, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and business teams to ensure consistent integration and operational alignment.
  • Document CDN architectures, configurations, security standards, operational procedures, and technical best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, operational resilience, security controls, and overall CDN service efficiency.

    • Requirements:

  • Extensive senior-level experience managing Akamai and CDN platforms in enterprise-grade production environments.
  • Strong expertise in Akamai Property Manager, including the creation and administration of properties, rules, behaviors, origins, and caching policies.
  • Hands-on experience with Akamai edge security solutions, particularly App & API Protector, Kona Site Defender (WAF), Bot Manager, and DDoS protection mechanisms.
  • Proven experience managing CDN certificates and TLS configurations using Akamai CPS, as well as DNS management through Edge DNS and traffic routing.
  • In-depth knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS protocols, caching strategies, request and response headers, cookies, compression, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, and web performance optimization.
  • Experience monitoring and troubleshooting edge traffic using Akamai Control Center, DataStream, mPulse, or equivalent monitoring and analytics platforms.
  • Practical experience with CDN automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Akamai CLI, Akamai APIs (PAPI), Terraform, and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience integrating CDN solutions with web applications and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), particularly regarding caching strategies and cache invalidation through Fast Purge.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including origin infrastructure and application architectures.
  • Proven experience in production support, incident management, root cause analysis, and technical change management.
  • Advanced or fluent English proficiency is mandatory, with the ability to communicate effectively in international technical environments.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex infrastructure and performance challenges.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with multidisciplinary technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • A proactive, autonomous, and solution-oriented mindset, with strong ownership of operational responsibilities.

    • Additional qualifications considered an advantage:

  • Akamai certifications, such as Akamai Certified Solutions Architect or relevant technical certifications from Akamai University.
  • Experience with Akamai EdgeWorkers and Image & Video Manager.
  • Knowledge of other CDN platforms, including Cloudflare, Fastly, Azure Front Door, and Amazon CloudFront.
  • Scripting experience with Python, Bash, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience implementing advanced automation and security practices across large-scale distributed infrastructure environments.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement within Brazil.
  • Full-time engagement with an initial contract duration of 12 months.
  • Senior-level technical position with significant ownership of enterprise CDN architecture and operations.
  • Opportunity to work with advanced Akamai content delivery, security, and performance optimization technologies.
  • Exposure to complex enterprise infrastructure and cloud environments.
  • Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams across cloud, infrastructure, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and application development.
  • Opportunity to drive automation, infrastructure modernization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Professional exposure to large-scale production environments and mission-critical digital services.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engenheiro(a) de IA Sr. based in Brazil.

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to build and maintain the technical infrastructure powering AI models and intelligent agents in a production environment within the financial sector. In this role, you will own the journey from experimentation to deployment, ensuring that AI solutions are reliable, secure, observable, and scalable. You will develop advanced applications using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), large language models, and autonomous agents integrated with enterprise data and transactional systems. Combining software engineering expertise with MLOps and LLMOps practices, you will establish robust deployment pipelines, monitoring capabilities, and operational controls. This is an opportunity to work on complex AI initiatives in a regulated environment, helping transform innovative concepts into dependable, production-ready solutions.

lists.content:
• Build and maintain end-to-end deployment pipelines, including version control, automated testing, controlled releases, and rollback procedures.

  • Implement and manage MLOps practices, including model registries, training and inference pipelines, automated retraining, monitoring, and model drift detection.

  • Develop LLMOps capabilities such as unified model gateways, prompt versioning, automated evaluation, and caching mechanisms.

  • Design and build RAG-based applications and AI agents, including agent execution harnesses, context management, skills, tools, and execution controls.

  • Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data sources, APIs, and transactional systems, including integrations through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Monitor and optimize system quality, availability, latency, throughput, and operational costs, ensuring traceability at the usage level.

  • Implement AI security measures, guardrails, access controls, and data protection mechanisms in accordance with regulated-environment requirements.

  • Investigate production incidents, troubleshoot failures, and maintain recovery procedures and operational documentation.

  • Ensure the reliability, reproducibility, security, and observability of AI models and agent-based applications throughout their lifecycle.

    • Requirements:

  • Professional experience in software engineering applied to data systems and artificial intelligence.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and practical experience with Apache Spark.

  • Hands-on experience implementing MLOps and LLMOps architectures and workflows.

  • Understanding of agent execution harnesses, including execution cycles, state management, checkpoints, recovery, and failure handling.

  • Knowledge of context engineering, including information selection, memory management, token limits, and isolation between sessions and users.

  • Experience implementing agent skills, tool calling, and MCP integrations to provide agents with access to tools and capabilities.

  • Practical knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, information retrieval, and context relevance evaluation.

  • Experience with cloud platforms, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code.

  • Strong understanding of production performance factors, including latency, throughput, cost per request, and system failure scenarios.

  • Knowledge of AI security practices, including guardrails, permissions, secrets management, and protection against prompt injection.

  • Experience working in regulated environments with strict auditability, compliance, and traceability requirements.

  • Nice to have: Experience in financial services; familiarity with vector databases and model-serving platforms; experience with multi-agent orchestration and frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain; and knowledge of FinOps practices applied to AI consumption.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote work arrangement.

  • Full-time engagement under a contractor (PJ) arrangement.

  • Opportunity to work on advanced AI engineering initiatives in the financial services sector.

  • Exposure to production-scale AI platforms, LLMOps, MLOps, RAG, and intelligent agent architectures.

  • Opportunity to contribute to the architecture and evolution of secure, scalable, and reliable AI solutions.

  • Create and maintain Python command-line interface (CLI) applications.

  • Design reusable components, transformation plugins, and workflow engines.

  • Work with different file formats, including JSON, CSV, and fixed-width or positional files.

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, ensuring performance and efficiency.

  • Build and maintain applications in Linux environments, including file and process management.

  • Collections and data structures.

  • Threading and multiprocessing.

  • String and substring manipulation, including regular expressions (Regex).

  • Context management.

  • Views, stored procedures, and triggers.

  • Query optimization and performance analysis.

  • Indexing and table partitioning.

  • Solid knowledge of relational databases.

  • Hands-on experience with ETL processes, including data extraction, transformation, and ingestion from multiple sources.

  • Experience developing Python CLI applications using tools such as argparse and click, as well as package distribution.

  • Familiarity with reading and processing positional files, COBOL, or EBCDIC formats.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Manager - Pipelines based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead a globally distributed team responsible for building and scaling a managed data pipeline and change data capture product. In this role, you will oversee the development and operation of systems that replicate data from PostgreSQL databases to analytical platforms and other destinations. You will combine technical expertise with strong people leadership, taking ownership of team development, engineering delivery, and product reliability. Working closely with senior engineers and cross-functional stakeholders, you will establish technical standards, manage priorities, and ensure dependable data replication, recovery, and performance. You will also guide hiring, roadmap execution, incident management, and continuous improvement within a remote-first environment. This is an opportunity to shape a developer-focused data product while building a high-performing engineering team in a fast-moving, open-source technology ecosystem.

lists.content:
As Engineering Manager - Pipelines, you will lead the people, technical delivery, and operational responsibilities of the Pipelines engineering team, ensuring the successful development and reliability of complex data replication systems. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Team Leadership and Development: Build and maintain a healthy, high-trust engineering culture within a globally distributed and remote-first team.

  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, manage performance evaluations, support career development, and oversee onboarding for direct reports.

  • Handle team administration, including leave management, time-off requests, and other people-related responsibilities.

  • Hiring and Team Growth: Own the team's hiring strategy and recruitment process, acting as the hiring manager and conducting initial interviews for all team positions.

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to identify, attract, interview, and recruit high-performing engineering professionals.

  • Contribute to workforce planning, organizational design, headcount allocation, and the continued development of engineering leadership.

  • Roadmap and Delivery Management: Own the team's technical roadmap and project management processes, using Linear to establish priorities, milestones, and accountability.

  • Manage incoming requests and communications through Slack and other internal channels, ensuring cross-functional requests are appropriately prioritized, assigned, or challenged.

  • Coordinate weekly progress updates and maintain clear communication with stakeholders without introducing unnecessary administrative overhead.

  • Allocate engineering resources to customer support tickets and ensure the team consistently meets its Service Level Objectives (SLOs).

  • Identify and communicate technical risks, dependencies, priorities, and trade-offs to senior leadership in a timely manner.

  • Technical Quality and Reliability: Participate in technical design discussions and help establish high engineering standards across architecture, testing, deployment, and operations.

  • Ensure data pipeline systems maintain correctness, ordering, reliable replication, and effective recovery mechanisms.

  • Support the development and operation of PostgreSQL replication infrastructure, including logical replication, replication slots, and Write-Ahead Log (WAL) retention.

  • Incident Management: Train and operate as an Incident Commander, coordinating teams during production incidents and driving timely resolution.

  • Lead blameless post-incident reviews, ensuring lessons learned are translated into concrete follow-up actions and long-term reliability improvements.

  • Help design, implement, monitor, and report on Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) at the enterprise level.

  • Track risk performance against established thresholds and escalate breaches or emerging concerns when necessary.

  • Prepare clear and comprehensive risk dashboards, reports, and presentations for governance forums, senior management, and Risk Committees.

  • Contribute analytical insights and recommendations to executive-level and Board reporting.

  • Support the development and maintenance of risk management policies, procedures, standards, and documentation.

  • Contribute to annual reviews of the risk appetite framework and the definition of appropriate risk thresholds.

  • Monitor identified risk issues and remediation action plans, following up with business stakeholders to ensure timely resolution.

  • Identify emerging risks and support scenario analysis and other forward-looking risk assessment activities.

  • Promote enterprise risk awareness through workshops, training sessions, and ongoing collaboration with business teams.

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in enterprise risk management, internal audit, compliance, or related functions, preferably within financial services, payments, or FinTech.

  • Working knowledge of established enterprise risk management frameworks, such as COSO ERM, ISO 31000, or equivalent methodologies.

  • Practical experience maintaining risk registers, developing and monitoring KRIs, and preparing governance and management reports.

We are seeking an experienced Flight Monitoring Specialist to support group air travel operations for meetings, conferences, and corporate events. In this fully remote, part-time role, you will monitor flight itineraries, anticipate travel disruptions, and coordinate timely solutions to keep travelers moving smoothly. You will leverage your airline ticketing, Global Distribution System (GDS), and flight-tracking expertise to manage delays, cancellations, and other unexpected situations. Working closely with air operations and event teams, you will provide responsive assistance and ensure travelers receive accurate information and effective support. This opportunity offers a flexible way to remain connected to the travel industry while applying your operational knowledge in a dynamic environment. It is particularly suited to independent travel professionals seeking flexible working arrangements or supplemental income.

lists.content:
As a Flight Monitoring Specialist, you will oversee group travel itineraries and proactively manage flight disruptions to ensure a smooth travel experience for attendees and event participants. You will use specialized travel systems, airline knowledge, and problem-solving skills to identify issues, coordinate alternative arrangements, and communicate effectively with relevant stakeholders.

  • Monitor group travelers' flight itineraries and proactively identify delays, cancellations, weather-related disruptions, and other potential travel issues.

  • Track flight statuses using specialized monitoring platforms and identify situations requiring immediate intervention.

  • Rebook and reticket travelers when disruptions occur, ensuring alternative arrangements are coordinated efficiently.

  • Research and resolve complex travel challenges using GDS platforms, airline fare rules, and flight-tracking tools.

  • Interpret and apply airline fare conditions, ticketing policies, and applicable travel regulations when making itinerary changes.

  • Communicate flight disruptions, alternative arrangements, and resolution updates to internal event teams and affected travelers.

  • Provide prompt, professional, and customer-focused assistance during irregular travel operations.

  • Coordinate with air purchasing and operations teams to ensure consistent support and effective disruption management.

  • Manage multiple travel situations simultaneously while prioritizing urgent requests and time-sensitive changes.

  • Maintain accurate information regarding flight statuses, rebookings, and traveler support activities.

  • Work independently while ensuring reliable coverage during assigned shifts and peak travel periods.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in the travel industry, particularly airline ticketing, GDS systems, and flight operations. You should be comfortable handling unexpected travel disruptions, making quick decisions, and communicating clearly with travelers and internal teams. Strong customer service skills, operational knowledge, and the ability to work independently in a flexible environment are essential.

  • Previous professional experience in a travel-related role involving airline ticketing and GDS systems is required.

  • Strong understanding of airline ticketing procedures, fare rules, and itinerary modifications.

  • Experience with Travelport+ is strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with flight-monitoring platforms such as FlightStats and FlightAware.

  • Proven ability to manage flight disruptions, including delays, cancellations, weather-related issues, and emergency rebooking situations.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick, informed decisions under pressure.

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Ability to manage multiple requests and prioritize urgent travel situations effectively.

  • Knowledge of both domestic and international travel procedures.

  • Experience in corporate travel, group travel, meetings, or event-related travel is preferred.

  • Previous experience handling airline irregular operations and coordinating alternative travel arrangements is an advantage.

  • Strong geographical knowledge and familiarity with international destinations.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with operational teams.

  • Flexibility to provide coverage during early mornings, evenings, weekends, and peak travel periods.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement.

  • Flexible, part-time working opportunity.

  • Opportunity to maintain and apply professional travel industry expertise without committing to a full-time position.

  • Potential to supplement existing income through flexible assignments.

  • Opportunity to remain connected to the travel and airline industry.

  • Varied operational responsibilities involving group travel, meetings, conferences, and events.

  • Opportunity to leverage existing airline ticketing, GDS, and travel management skills.

  • Collaborative working environment with an experienced air purchasing and operations team.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering and deploying enterprise-grade technical integrations. You will work at the intersection of backend engineering, APIs, telephony, databases, and AI-powered workflows. Your mission will be to connect complex customer systems and build reliable, scalable solutions that automate real business processes. Working closely with enterprise customers, product teams, and core engineering, you will take ownership of technical delivery from initial requirements through production deployment. You will troubleshoot complex issues, improve system reliability, and turn customer-specific needs into reusable platform capabilities. This is a high-impact, hands-on opportunity in a fast-paced, remote environment, collaborating with US-based customers during overlapping working hours.

lists.content:
• Own the end-to-end delivery of production integrations across CRM, ATS, telephony, and internal enterprise systems.
  • Design and implement reliable data flows between the platform and external applications.
  • Manage authentication, API rate limits, retries, and failure handling across distributed systems.
  • Investigate, debug, and resolve complex production issues involving webhooks, asynchronous workflows, and external APIs.
  • Improve logging, monitoring, and observability across deployment pipelines to ensure system reliability.
  • Translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical specifications and implementation plans.
  • Identify recurring integration patterns and transform individual solutions into reusable connectors, tools, and platform improvements.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to incorporate customer feedback and deployment insights into the core platform.
  • Take ownership of technical decisions, balancing implementation scope, scalability, and customer impact.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 2 years of experience in software engineering, technical consulting, or a customer-facing engineering role.
  • A degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience working with APIs and relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL.
  • Proven experience integrating third-party systems and managing external APIs in production environments.
  • Good understanding of distributed systems concepts, including idempotency, retries, asynchronous processing, and error handling.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve production issues under time pressure.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts, implementation decisions, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A proactive ownership mindset, with the ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and take responsibility for end-to-end delivery.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience with telephony integrations, event-driven systems, or webhook-based architectures.
  • Exposure to AI-powered workflows, automation platforms, or Large Language Model (LLM) integrations.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers, particularly in consulting, banking, or similar environments.

    • What success looks like within your first 90 days:

  • Independently own at least one enterprise deployment from start to finish.
  • Successfully identify and resolve a significant production issue.
  • Deliver at least one reusable technical improvement that reduces the effort required for future deployments.
  • Demonstrate sound technical judgment when managing priorities, evaluating trade-offs, and addressing customer needs.

    • Benefits:

  • Full-time employment opportunity.
  • Fully remote working arrangement, based in Brazil.
  • Opportunity to collaborate directly with US-based enterprise customers.
  • Hands-on exposure to enterprise integrations, AI-powered automation, APIs, and telephony systems.
  • High level of ownership and autonomy over technical projects and production deployments.
  • Opportunity to work closely with product and engineering teams and influence the evolution of platform capabilities.
  • Professional growth through challenging technical problems and direct customer engagement.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Freelance Editor - Astrum Earth based in Brazil.

This is an exciting opportunity for a talented freelance video editor to create engaging, high-quality documentary content exploring the science and wonders of our planet. You will produce long-form YouTube videos combining live-action footage, animation, sound design, and compelling storytelling to make complex Earth science topics accessible to a broad audience. Working alongside researchers, scriptwriters, voice-over artists, and animators, you will help transform scientific discoveries into visually captivating stories. You will play an important role in maintaining the channel's distinctive editorial style while ensuring high production standards across multiple projects. Joining a growing international digital media environment, you will have the flexibility to work remotely while contributing to educational and inspiring content.

lists.content:
As a Freelance Editor, you will be responsible for transforming research and creative concepts into polished documentary-style videos. You will collaborate closely with the production team to ensure that every project meets editorial expectations, maintains storytelling consistency, and is delivered on schedule.

  • Edit high-quality, long-form video content for a YouTube channel focused on Earth sciences, combining live-action footage and animation.

  • Source, select, organize, and import appropriate media assets, including videos, images, and audio elements.

  • Implement professional sound design and ensure seamless integration of audio with visual storytelling.

  • Verify that all media assets are properly licensed, rights-cleared, and compliant with applicable legal requirements.

  • Collaborate with scriptwriters, researchers, voice-over artists, and production team members to understand creative briefs and align editing decisions with the intended narrative.

  • Manage multiple editing projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks effectively and meeting agreed deadlines.

  • Maintain organized project files, media assets, and documentation to facilitate efficient collaboration and future access.

  • Prepare detailed animation briefs and work closely with animators to ensure that visual content meets project requirements.

  • Review animation deliverables and provide feedback to maintain consistency with the overall storytelling vision.

  • Maintain the channel's established visual identity, editorial style, and quality standards.

  • Communicate regularly with team members, provide progress updates, and flag potential delays or production challenges.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced video editor with strong documentary storytelling abilities, technical expertise, and a genuine interest in Earth sciences. You should be comfortable managing several creative projects independently while collaborating with a distributed production team to deliver engaging digital content.

  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience, supported by a relevant showreel or portfolio demonstrating previous work.

  • Strong experience creating digital content, particularly long-form YouTube videos.

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe Creative Cloud.

  • Excellent documentary storytelling skills, with the ability to structure engaging narratives through visual editing.

  • Essential experience in sound design and the ability to integrate audio elements effectively into video productions.

  • Genuine passion for Earth sciences and the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts in an accessible and engaging way.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high editorial and production standards.

  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with creative and production teams.

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and provide consistent progress updates.

    • Additional experience that would be advantageous includes:

  • Previous experience editing documentaries or educational science content.

  • Strong understanding of YouTube and other social media platforms, including content optimization and audience engagement.

  • Familiarity with animation workflows and collaboration with motion designers or animation teams.

  • Experience working in remote, international creative production environments.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement, with the freedom to work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Opportunity to collaborate with an international team of creative professionals.

  • A dynamic, fast-paced, and innovative working environment.

  • Supportive, inclusive, and collaborative company culture.

  • Opportunities to develop professionally, take ownership of creative projects, and expand your skills.

  • Opportunity to contribute to educational content that inspires curiosity and promotes scientific understanding.

  • Exposure to a growing digital media and creator economy environment.

  • Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities.

  • Access to initiatives supporting emerging creators and organizations driving positive social and environmental impact.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Freelance Home Video Recording Contributor based in Brazil.

We are looking for freelance contributors to participate in a remote data collection project supporting the development and improvement of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies. In this role, you will record first-person (POV) videos of everyday household activities using a smartphone mounted on a headband or forehead strap. Your recordings will help generate real-world visual data used in AI training and development projects. Activities will include cooking, cleaning, doing laundry, organizing spaces, and other common household tasks. You will capture these activities naturally through a dedicated mobile application, following simple project guidelines. No previous experience in video production or data annotation is required, making this a flexible opportunity to earn additional income from home while completing your usual daily routines.

lists.content:
• Record first-person (POV) videos of everyday household activities using a compatible smartphone attached to a head-mounted support or forehead strap.
  • Capture natural, real-life activities such as cooking, preparing meals, washing dishes, doing laundry, folding clothes, making beds, and cleaning different areas of the home.
  • Record household organization activities, including tidying spaces, arranging belongings, caring for plants, and performing other routine domestic tasks.
  • Use the designated mobile application to select available activities and submit video recordings according to the project instructions.
  • Follow the provided recording guidelines to ensure that videos meet the required quality standards and project specifications.
  • Ensure that recordings accurately capture the activities from a first-person perspective without requiring acting or speaking in front of the camera.
  • Submit recorded videos through the application for review and approval by the client.
  • Follow project deadlines and instructions while managing recording activities independently and flexibly.
  • Complete the required onboarding process, including account creation, profile registration, and submission of any necessary documentation.

    • Requirements:

  • Must be at least 18 years old.
  • Must currently reside in an eligible Latin American country.
  • Must have access to a compatible smartphone capable of recording the required first-person videos.
  • Must own or have access to a headband or forehead strap suitable for securely mounting a smartphone.
  • Must have a stable internet connection to access the recording application and upload video submissions.
  • Must be comfortable recording everyday household activities from a first-person perspective.
  • Must be able to follow detailed instructions and comply with project recording guidelines.
  • Must demonstrate attention to detail and the ability to complete and submit recordings independently.
  • No previous experience in data annotation, video production, or professional filming is required.
  • No acting experience or on-camera speaking is necessary.

    • Compatible Equipment:

    You must have a forehead strap or head-mounted smartphone holder and one of the following compatible devices:

  • Apple iPhone: Models 13 through 17, excluding iPhone 16e and iPhone 17e.
  • Google Pixel: Pixel 6 or newer models.
  • Samsung Galaxy: Galaxy S21 or newer models within the S series.

    • Benefits:

  • Remote Work: Complete all recording activities from the comfort of your own home.
  • Flexible Schedule: Choose when to record, subject to project instructions and submission deadlines.
  • Compensation: USD 5 per approved hour of video recording.
  • Payment Structure: Compensation is calculated based on the number of video hours recorded and approved by the client through the application.
  • Fixed Rate: The compensation rate is non-negotiable.
  • No Previous Experience Required: No professional video recording or data annotation background is necessary.
  • Everyday Activities: Earn additional income by recording household activities that are already part of your daily routine.
  • Simple Onboarding: Receive step-by-step instructions, project guidelines, and documentation before starting.
  • Flexible Freelance Opportunity: Work independently without a fixed daily schedule or traditional office requirements.

    • How to Get Started:

  • Submit your application through the recruitment platform.
  • Receive an email with compensation details and confirm that your smartphone and recording equipment meet the project requirements.
  • Follow the instructions to create your TrustScale account and complete your profile.
  • Review the project guidelines and submit any required documentation.
  • Once your registration is complete and everything is approved, you can begin recording and submitting videos through the designated application.

  • Implement new functionalities, resolve software defects, and continuously improve existing applications.

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience with React.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
  • Solid knowledge of HTML and CSS, with the ability to develop and maintain modern frontend interfaces.

You will oversee a globally distributed creative organisation, guiding multidisciplinary teams across branding, advertising, social media, presentations, print, and digital experiences.

lists.content:

  • Ensure all creative deliverables align with customer objectives, brand strategies, creative briefs, and broader business outcomes.

  • Act as a senior creative representative for enterprise customers, building strong relationships, maintaining trust, and ensuring consistently high-quality creative experiences.

  • Partner closely with the General Manager and Account Director to support customer retention, account expansion, and long-term business growth.

  • Ensure creative leadership contributes directly to customer satisfaction, successful project delivery, and contract renewal outcomes.

  • Help standardise the customer experience across the entire journey, from onboarding and creative strategy through production and ongoing delivery.

  • Guide creative teams in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, consistency, and scalability without compromising originality or creative craftsmanship.

  • Collaborate with Automation, Web, and AI specialists to align creative vision with technical capabilities, production tools, and operational workflows.

  • Ensure AI-enabled creative processes support repeatable, efficient, and scalable delivery models that meet enterprise-level requirements.

  • Develop leadership capabilities across the organisation, increasing team autonomy and reducing reliance on direct senior-level intervention.

  • Support creative leaders in balancing ambitious creative concepts with operational constraints, delivery expectations, and customer priorities.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement across creative teams.

  • Define and promote a shared vision of creative excellence in an AI-enabled environment.

  • Encourage inclusive leadership, psychological safety, and adaptability during periods of organisational and technological change.

  • Reinforce consistent creative standards, review processes, and delivery expectations across teams.

  • Connect creative strategy with studio-level priorities, operational planning, and performance objectives.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 15 years of professional experience leading creative teams and managing large-scale creative projects.

  • Proven experience operating at Group Creative Director, Executive Creative Director, or an equivalent senior creative leadership level.

  • Strong background in enterprise-level creative delivery across multiple channels, formats, and disciplines.

  • Extensive understanding of modern creative workflows and the practical application of generative AI from initial concept development through final production.

  • Advanced proficiency in generative AI tools and workflows, with the ability to integrate them strategically into creative leadership and production processes.

  • Familiarity with AI platforms such as Krea, Flora, Weavy, Nano Banana, Sora, or comparable generative AI solutions.

  • A strong creative portfolio demonstrating strategic vision, storytelling capabilities, artistic direction, and creative systems thinking.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior decision-makers and communicate creative vision effectively.

  • Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers, senior client stakeholders, and executive leadership.

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities, with experience developing creative talent, empowering management teams, and establishing consistent standards across large organisations.

  • Ability to balance creative ambition with commercial objectives, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

  • A forward-thinking mindset and genuine enthusiasm for exploring how AI can enhance human creativity and transform creative production.

  • Comfortable leading globally distributed teams and collaborating across different cultures, disciplines, and time zones.

  • Adaptability, resilience, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities and technologies evolve continuously.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working environment, with the flexibility to work from anywhere.

  • Opportunity to collaborate with a globally distributed team representing more than 60 nationalities and multiple creative disciplines.

  • High-trust, performance-driven culture that encourages direct feedback, continuous learning, and collaborative problem-solving.

  • Opportunity to influence the evolution of the global creative industry through the integration of generative AI and emerging technologies.

  • Inclusive and diverse working environment that values different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

  • Autonomy and flexibility within an asynchronous, remote-first organisation.

  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a growing business that combines creative excellence, technology, and global collaboration.

You will take ownership of the entire marketing funnel, from attracting qualified prospects and increasing website traffic to nurturing leads and generating sales opportunities. Working across multiple acquisition channels, you will combine organic growth strategies, campaign optimization, and data-driven experimentation to improve marketing performance. You will collaborate with SEO, PPC, content, design, development, and sales specialists while independently managing initiatives from research through execution and analysis. lists.content:
• Develop and execute multi-channel lead-generation strategies that attract qualified prospects, improve conversion rates, and support business growth.

  • Own and optimize the complete lead-generation funnel, from traffic acquisition and lead capture through Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs), and sales opportunities.

  • Maintain accountability for lead quality, pipeline contribution, and the overall effectiveness of marketing initiatives.

  • Manage marketing projects end to end, including market research, strategic planning, campaign development, execution, testing, performance analysis, and continuous optimization.

  • Plan and implement organic-first, multi-channel growth programs, coordinating SEO, PPC, content, design, and development specialists to achieve campaign objectives.

  • Identify new growth opportunities through market research, competitor analysis, audience insights, and marketing performance data.

  • Monitor and report on the entire lead-generation funnel, analyzing traffic acquisition, landing-page engagement, lead capture, nurturing, qualification, and conversion.

  • Plan and execute conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives to improve user experience, increase conversions, and strengthen lead-generation performance.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Influencer Marketing based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Head of Influencer Marketing to lead and scale paid creator partnerships within the gaming industry. In this senior, hands-on role, you will own the influencer marketing strategy, with a primary focus on YouTube long-form sponsorships and profitable creator collaborations. You will manage the full partnership lifecycle, from identifying creators and negotiating sponsorship agreements to monitoring campaign performance and driving long-term relationships. Working with an existing portfolio of 30–40 creators, you will help expand the network to more than 50 active partnerships while identifying new growth opportunities. You will also take ownership of sponsorship budgets, commercial decisions, and team development as the function scales. This is an opportunity to shape a growing influencer marketing operation in a fully remote environment with significant commercial responsibility.

lists.content:
Lead the influencer marketing function, taking direct ownership of creator partnerships, sponsorship investments, campaign profitability, and long-term commercial growth. You will initially remain closely involved in daily operations while gradually developing the team, processes, and infrastructure needed to manage an expanding creator portfolio.

  • Identify, research, source, and evaluate gaming YouTubers and other relevant content creators, prioritizing long-form YouTube sponsorship opportunities.

  • Manage paid creator partnerships across YouTube long-form, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, and other relevant platforms, with approximately 90% of activities focused on long-form YouTube content.

  • Build, manage, and expand a portfolio of more than 50 active creator relationships, maintaining a consistent pipeline for outreach, negotiations, contracted content, follow-ups, payments, reporting, and renewals.

  • Develop long-term creator relationships through recurring sponsorship agreements covering multiple content releases over several months or years.

  • Personally negotiate sponsorship budgets, pricing, and commercial terms with creators, talent managers, and influencer agencies.

  • Determine appropriate partnership structures, including fixed-fee, CPM-based, hybrid, performance-linked, and multi-video agreements.

  • Evaluate creator opportunities based on expected views, audience demographics, conversion potential, contribution margins, seasonal demand, and overall campaign profitability.

  • Independently assess the commercial value of each partnership and determine appropriate investment levels based on expected returns.

  • Adapt sponsorship budgets and renegotiate agreements according to product releases, promotional periods, seasonal trends, and changing market conditions.

  • Consider product margins, game popularity, audience geography, seasonality, and historical campaign performance when making investment decisions.

  • Maintain accountability for sponsorship spending and profitability, evaluating commercial results rather than focusing exclusively on impressions, reach, or outreach activity.

  • Manage a substantial monthly sponsorship budget while maintaining clear visibility into spending, commitments, and campaign outcomes.

  • Prioritize multiple creator commitments and ensure consistent follow-through across negotiations, deliverables, payments, performance reporting, and renewals.

  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, expand successful partnerships, and scale profitable creator collaborations.

  • Initially provide guidance and support to an existing team member while remaining directly involved in creator relationship management.

  • Gradually recruit, train, and manage additional operational support, including influencer marketing coordinators and account managers.

  • Develop scalable processes and team structures to support the expansion of the creator portfolio.

  • Progressively shift focus toward strategic growth, major negotiations, high-value partnerships, and overall commercial leadership.

    • Requirements:

    We are looking for a highly experienced influencer marketing professional with substantial hands-on expertise in paid YouTube long-form sponsorships and direct commercial ownership. The ideal candidate combines strong negotiation skills, financial awareness, and a deep understanding of gaming audiences with the ability to independently manage a significant creator portfolio and deliver profitable partnerships.

  • Significant, directly relevant experience managing paid YouTube long-form sponsorships across multiple creators and campaigns. This must represent a substantial part of your previous experience rather than occasional exposure to a few integrations.

  • Proven commercial ownership, including personally setting or significantly influencing sponsorship pricing, negotiating partnership structures, and evaluating campaign profitability.

  • Experience independently managing a meaningful monthly sponsorship budget, with the ability to clearly explain the amount personally controlled rather than the overall budget managed by an agency or organization.

  • Strong negotiation experience across different deal structures, creator sizes, audience demographics, and products.

  • Demonstrated experience developing recurring sponsorship agreements and long-term creator partnerships rather than relying exclusively on one-off campaigns.

  • Practical understanding of how product margins, game popularity, audience geography, seasonality, and campaign results influence sponsorship pricing and investment decisions.

  • Experience managing a substantial portfolio of active creator relationships while balancing multiple commercial commitments and deadlines.

  • Working knowledge of short-form sponsorship content, including YouTube Shorts and repurposed TikTok and Instagram content, while maintaining long-form YouTube sponsorships as your primary area of expertise.

  • Strong understanding of gaming creators, YouTube audiences, and the broader gaming content ecosystem.

  • Excellent written English communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

  • Ability to work independently, make commercially sound decisions, and take full ownership of results.

  • Nice to have:

  • Established relationships with gaming YouTubers, talent managers, or creator agencies.

  • Experience directly managing 50–100+ active paid creator partnerships.

  • Previous experience recruiting, mentoring, or managing influencer marketing coordinators or account managers.

  • Experience negotiating bundled short-form placements, content reuse rights, and additional cross-platform promotional opportunities.

  • Background working with digital gaming products, niche e-commerce products, or seasonal performance-marketing categories.

  • Familiarity with influencer marketing CRM platforms, campaign performance reporting tools, and WordPress.

    • Benefits:

  • Monthly base salary ranging from $2,000 to $3,000 USD, depending on experience and qualifications.

  • Full-time, long-term employment opportunity.

  • 100% remote working arrangement from eligible Latin American countries.

  • Monday-to-Friday core working schedule, with approximately 8 hours per day.

  • Preferred availability for approximately one additional hour per day on Saturdays and Sundays, with some overlap with Australian Eastern Time (GMT+10).

  • Occasional flexibility for short-notice coordination around major game releases and promotional periods.

  • Paid vacation leave after three months.

  • Potential performance-based bonuses.

  • Opportunity to progress into broader commercial leadership responsibilities.

  • Opportunity to build and lead a dedicated influencer marketing support team.

  • Significant ownership of sponsorship strategy, commercial decisions, and creator partnership growth.

We are seeking an experienced and highly autonomous Head of Operations to lead the operational infrastructure of a rapidly growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) wellness and subscription business. Reporting directly to the Founder, you will take ownership of the company's entire operational ecosystem, from supply chain management and manufacturing to fulfillment, quality assurance, and customer experience operations. You will play a pivotal role in building scalable systems, strengthening supplier relationships, optimizing costs, and improving operational efficiency. Working in a lean, fast-paced environment, you will have the autonomy to make strategic decisions while remaining closely involved in day-to-day execution. This is an opportunity to shape the operational foundation of an ambitious business and directly influence its long-term growth and profitability.

lists.content:
As Head of Operations, you will oversee all operational functions, establish efficient processes, and lead cross-functional execution to support sustainable business expansion. You will work closely with the Founder and other functional leaders to eliminate bottlenecks, improve performance, and build a scalable operational structure.

  • Supply Chain & Inventory Management:

  • Own end-to-end supply chain operations, including demand forecasting, inventory planning, purchase orders, and replenishment.

  • Develop reliable inventory forecasting systems to prevent stockouts and excess inventory.

  • Oversee third-party logistics (3PL) partners and ensure fulfillment operations scale efficiently with increasing order volumes.

  • Improve production planning, strengthen supplier coordination, and reduce manufacturing lead times.

  • Manufacturing & Cost Optimization:

  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard supplement manufacturers across the United States and China.

  • Lead commercial negotiations to secure competitive pricing, improved payment terms, and favorable production agreements.

  • Optimize cost of goods sold (COGS) while maintaining product quality and operational standards.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with manufacturers and strategic suppliers.

  • Quality Assurance & Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure manufacturing partners comply with applicable supplement industry standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Oversee Certificates of Analysis (COAs), certifications, current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) documentation, and quality assurance processes.

  • Establish quality control procedures to minimize product defects, compliance risks, and potential recalls.

  • Ensure manufacturing and product labeling processes meet relevant US regulatory requirements.

  • Product Development & Launch Operations:

  • Lead operational planning and readiness for new product and SKU launches.

  • Coordinate packaging, manufacturing, inventory availability, and fulfillment requirements.

  • Ensure cross-functional teams remain aligned with product launch schedules and operational milestones.

  • Identify opportunities to improve existing product and packaging processes.

  • Customer Experience Operations:

  • Oversee the Head of Customer Support and ensure customer service operations can scale alongside business growth.

  • Monitor and improve key customer experience metrics, particularly returns, refunds, and payment chargebacks.

  • Collaborate with customer support teams to identify recurring issues and implement effective solutions.

  • Develop processes that protect customer satisfaction while controlling unnecessary operational costs.

  • Vendor Management, Legal & Brand Protection:

  • Review agency, software, and third-party vendor expenses to identify opportunities for cost optimization.

  • Oversee vendor contracts, commercial agreements, and operational legal matters.

  • Coordinate brand protection initiatives, including identifying and addressing counterfeit products and unauthorized copycats.

  • Establish appropriate operational controls and compliance procedures.

  • Operational Infrastructure & Leadership:

  • Build scalable standard operating procedures (SOPs), workflows, reporting structures, and operational dashboards.

  • Define, monitor, and improve key operational performance indicators (KPIs).

  • Lead cross-functional execution across operations, customer experience, creative, and other business functions.

  • Build, manage, and develop the operations team as the business expands.

  • Take full ownership of operational execution and proactively resolve bottlenecks before they affect business performance.

  • First 90-Day Priorities:

  • Assume ownership of day-to-day operations, significantly reducing the Founder's involvement in operational execution.

  • Rebuild inventory forecasting into a reliable, accessible reporting system, ideally supported by AI-powered automation.

  • Establish clear inventory ordering processes and stronger oversight of 3PL operations.

  • Define core operational KPIs and establish a consistent reporting cadence.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce COGS and negotiate better supplier pricing and payment terms.

  • Improve production planning and shorten manufacturing lead times.

  • Work with customer support teams to reduce returns and payment chargebacks.

  • Audit agency and software expenses and implement cost-saving initiatives.

  • Establish a scalable operational structure with clear responsibilities, SOPs, and accountability.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a commercially minded and execution-driven operations leader with significant experience scaling high-growth DTC businesses, preferably within the supplement, nutraceutical, or wellness industry. You should combine strategic thinking with hands-on operational expertise, demonstrate strong negotiation and leadership capabilities, and be comfortable making independent decisions in a fast-moving environment.

    Must-Have Qualifications:

  • Significant experience leading operations within high-growth direct-to-consumer (DTC) businesses, ideally organizations generating multiple eight-figure or nine-figure annual revenues.

  • Direct experience in the supplement, nutraceutical, or wellness industry, with a strong understanding of manufacturing, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance.

  • Proven expertise managing end-to-end supply chain operations, including demand forecasting, inventory management, purchase orders, and 3PL oversight.

  • Demonstrated experience sourcing, evaluating, and negotiating with manufacturers, particularly in the United States and China.

  • Strong knowledge of supplement manufacturing requirements, including COAs, cGMP standards, certifications, and quality control procedures.

  • Experience managing customer support operations and improving returns, refunds, and chargeback performance.

  • Previous experience leading teams and managing other functional leaders.

The Healthcare Sales & Patient Engagement Specialist will help prospective patients take the next step toward sleep apnea testing and treatment by turning incoming inquiries into completed purchases or medical submissions. This is a sales-focused remote opportunity combining lead conversion with empathetic patient communication. You will engage a high volume of prospects through phone calls, email, and SMS, explaining available care pathways and addressing questions or concerns. Working within a fast-paced environment handling approximately 3,500–4,000 patient leads per month, you will be responsible for maintaining an organized pipeline and achieving measurable conversion targets. You will also collaborate with clinical and operational teams to improve the patient journey, strengthen follow-up processes, and deliver a positive experience throughout each interaction.

lists.content:
You will manage the full engagement process for prospective patients, from initial contact through conversion and follow-up. Your work will combine persuasive sales communication, pipeline management, performance tracking, and coordination with internal teams to help patients access the appropriate next step in their care. Key responsibilities include:

  • Engage inbound leads through phone calls, email, and SMS to understand their needs and encourage appropriate next steps.

  • Convert prospective patients into completed purchases of diagnostic home sleep tests or submissions of existing sleep study results for medical review.

  • Clearly communicate the value of available sleep testing and treatment pathways.

  • Answer questions, address objections, build trust, and motivate prospects to move forward.

  • Execute structured outreach and follow-up strategies to reduce lead drop-off and recover unresponsive prospects.

  • Manage a high-volume pipeline using Salesforce and other CRM or patient management systems.

  • Prioritize leads based on engagement, status, and likelihood of conversion.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of patient interactions, lead status, and follow-up activities.

  • Monitor outreach activity, engagement levels, conversion rates, completion rates, and other key performance indicators.

  • Review individual performance and adjust sales and communication strategies to improve results.

  • Take ownership of conversion targets, productivity, and service quality while responding constructively to feedback.

  • Guide prospective patients through the steps required to progress with their care and identify barriers that may prevent them from doing so.

  • Escalate clinical or operational questions to the appropriate teams when necessary.

  • Collaborate with Clinical, Customer Experience, Marketing, and other internal teams to improve messaging, workflows, and conversion strategies.

  • Share insights from patient interactions to help improve the overall patient experience and sales funnel.

  • Deliver services professionally and consistently in accordance with agreed timelines, guidelines, and contractual deliverables.

    • Requirements:

    You are a persuasive, organized, and results-driven professional with experience in sales, lead generation, or customer engagement. You are comfortable working toward measurable targets, handling a large volume of prospects, and maintaining consistent follow-up while ensuring that patients feel informed and supported. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

  • At least 2 years of experience in sales, lead generation, customer engagement, or another performance-driven role.

  • Strong sales mindset with a clear focus on conversion targets, productivity, and measurable results.

  • Excellent spoken and written English, with a clear and professional communication style.

  • Confidence communicating with prospects and selling through phone calls, email, and SMS.

  • Ability to build rapport, explain value propositions, handle objections, and encourage prospects to take action.

  • Persistence and comfort with conducting multiple follow-ups to convert interested leads.

  • Ability to manage a high-volume pipeline in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing follow-ups and documenting interactions.

  • Accountability for individual performance goals and openness to coaching and constructive feedback.

  • Familiarity with CRM and patient management systems; Salesforce experience is an advantage.

  • Experience in healthcare, inside sales, or direct-to-consumer sales is preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, although equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

  • Proficiency with Salesforce, phone and VoIP communication platforms, email and SMS tools, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Teams, and AI-assisted productivity tools.

  • A patient-focused and empathetic approach, combined with confidence, persuasion, and a strong commitment to achieving results.

  • Availability to work a fixed U.S. Pacific Time schedule, including potential weekend shifts.

  • Competitive contractor compensation rates.

  • Remote work opportunity open to candidates worldwide.

  • Multiple opportunities may be available across different roles.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Influencer and Social Media Lead based remotely in Brazil.

In this strategic leadership role, you will shape and grow the brand’s organic digital presence across social media, search engines, and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. You will oversee social media strategy, influencer partnerships, and the development of engaging short-form and long-form content. Your mission will be to build a sustainable content ecosystem that drives visibility, trust, and long-term audience engagement. You will manage and develop a creative team while coordinating external agencies, creators, and production partners. From YouTube content and educational guides to influencer campaigns and digital PR, you will connect multiple channels into one cohesive strategy. This is an exciting opportunity to combine creativity, strategic thinking, team leadership, and measurable digital growth within the pet wellness industry.

lists.content:
• Social Media Strategy: Develop, grow, and optimize organic social media channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Define channel strategies, content formats, publishing frequency, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Editorial Planning: Create and manage an integrated editorial calendar across all organic channels, overseeing topics, timelines, resources, execution, and priorities.
  • Team and Influencer Management: Lead and develop the Creator and Influencer team by setting objectives, providing feedback, supporting professional growth, and managing capacity. Oversee influencer marketing campaigns from creator selection and briefing to relationship management and performance evaluation.
  • Long-Form and Evergreen Content: Develop and coordinate YouTube videos, blog articles, educational guides, and informative resources. Identify opportunities to transform campaign materials into lasting content assets that generate ongoing visibility and engagement.
  • Public Relations and Earned Media: Build relationships with specialist publications, online magazines, comparison platforms, review websites, and external publishers. Develop partnerships with educational creators, veterinarians, and other credible industry voices to strengthen brand authority and trust.
  • SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Drive organic visibility across traditional search engines and AI-generated search results. Identify relevant content opportunities, address visibility gaps, and translate insights into an effective editorial strategy.
  • Agency and Partner Coordination: Manage external agencies, freelancers, creators, and production partners, ensuring clear briefs, high-quality deliverables, efficient timelines, and responsible budget management.
  • Content Optimization: Monitor content performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and continuously refine formats and distribution strategies to maximize reach, engagement, and long-term discoverability.

    • Requirements:

  • Several years of experience developing and managing short-form, long-form, and evergreen content across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.
  • Proven experience managing external content producers, freelancers, creative partners, or agencies.
  • Previous experience in a team leadership role, either through direct management or functional leadership of content creators and social media professionals.
  • Strong SEO expertise, including both content strategy and technical SEO, beyond basic keyword research.
  • Demonstrated understanding of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI Search, including the factors that influence brand visibility in AI-generated answers.
  • Strong editorial judgment and attention to detail, particularly when creating educational or health-related content. Ability to prioritize credible sources, expert input, accuracy, and transparency.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German, along with good English proficiency.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple channels, campaigns, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Creative mindset combined with strategic thinking, ownership, and a results-oriented approach.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for dogs and cats, with an interest in pet health and well-being.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working opportunity, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world.
  • Permanent employment contract.
  • Opportunity to shape and develop the brand’s social media, influencer marketing, and organic content strategy.
  • Leadership responsibility with the opportunity to develop a creative and content-focused team.
  • Exposure to innovative digital marketing practices, including SEO, GEO, and AI-powered search visibility.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with creators, veterinarians, agencies, and industry experts.
  • A chance to contribute to a meaningful mission focused on improving the health and well-being of dogs.
